column2: [17] Fly or Die

Clearly identifying the potential threat of our overwhelming air power, the Arachnids have attacked and overrun the Fleet air base on Kwalasha.

To assure the enemy does not regain any momentum, M.I. troopers are eager to reclaim the facility and get their Fleet comrades back in the air.
Capture the Flight Control Tower
Secure all Satellite Stations
Clear all Arachnids around the Flight Control Tower
Kill 250 Arachnids
Survive the final wave
Satellite Station rewards:
• Hangars Section: Unlock the Fleet Liaison
Provides Fleet Relays for air strikes
• Warehouse Section: Unlock M9 Sledgehammers
Provides Support Center
• Power Plant Section: Unlock M6 Jaegers
Provides Power Plant and activates all Searchlights

How the hell did bugs get through the perimeter line? Those defences were iron tight!
Perhaps, but this air base certainly wasn’t designed to repel an attack.
Why establish an airbase here anyway?  These aircraft could be safe in orbit – now they’re just asking to be attacked.
I’m sure Command had their reasons.
Power troopers are dropping to secure an initial landing spot.
It's going to be a long night.
There are Bug Lairs around the tower. Take them all out.
Hangars secured! Get those strikes rolling!
Main power plant back online!
That area has been declared secure.
The tower area has been secured. Main force ready to drop.
Next we'll have to clear the rest of the airfield, including the Power Plant, ...
... the Hangars...
... and the Warehouse area.
Once that's done, we hold onto it no matter what the Bugs throw at us.
It looks like they have finally had enough!
Excellent work, but there’s no time to rest. Get to the shuttles, I have another task for you.
You have another task, Colonel?
On the Sky Marshal’s orders, of course.
They’re coming from every direction. Stay on your toes.
Maintain a 360-degree watch! You see an enemy, move to intercept!
Another attack is on its way!
Bugs detected, heading your way!
Congratulations on a most convincing performance. The trap has been sprung!
I’m not sure I understand...?
This airfield was just bait. Command created a target the Bugs could not resist to lure them out of their holes. Let them through the front line to be exposed out in the open.
But what about the aircraft? If they were destroyed...
They were never going to fly in the first place.  We built empty shells, fakes.  The real ones are airborne right now.  For once, it’s the Bugs who have underestimated us.
Next time you pull a stunt like this, I would appreciate being kept in the loop. Anyway, at least the plan worked. If the Federation wanted a target rich environment, they’ve got it.
Well that did not go to plan.
As predicted, the bugs are expending maximum effort to retake the airfield.
Damn it, protect those birds!
Defend those aircraft!
